title: Man Survived 76 Days Alone on a Tiny Life Raft — Steven Callahan.
note: Fact-checked against Wikipedia (Steven Callahan / Adrift, 1986). Departed El Hierro 29 Jan 1982; holed about 7 days out, probably by a whale (his own guess, so the line says 'Probably'). Raft: six-person Avon, about 6 ft across. Water: solar stills, just over a pint a day (he cut open the third still, so only two worked; narration just says he had three). Nine ships passed. ~1,800 nautical miles. Lost about a third of his weight. Rescued on day 76 (20-21 April 1982) by fishermen off Marie-Galante, near Guadeloupe, drawn by birds over the raft. The leak is kept general (days of pumping) because exact day counts vary between sources. Loop: last line runs into the first ('it's hard to believe… a man survived seventy-six days…').
